findings.message: Neither a usable row-level knowledge-time column nor a non-negative governed publication lag is available.
findings.remediation: Declare and validate a fully parseable knowledge-time column, or govern a non-negative publication lag before prototyping time-dependent features.
findings.risk: Without a usable knowledge timestamp or governed publication lag, a feature prototype cannot prove availability at prediction cutoff.
findings.title: Feature availability time is not governed

entries.statement: Do not derive same-period or future-looking features without enforcing observation and knowledge-time cutoffs.
Do not silently drop outliers, duplicates, missing periods, or unmapped entities from evidence.
Do not use raw close levels across contracts or across an unverified quote/unit regime break; verify contract quote units and continuity first.
Do not treat ingestion or file timestamps as historical publication dates.
Do not silently replace raw duplicate evidence with the consumer view.

entries.reason: The current contract does not prove cutoff-time availability.
entries.statement: Do not backfill latest or final values into earlier feature cutoffs.
